name: Cirák (Hungary)
description: White field with four green diagonal bands running from the corners towards the centre, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Cirák: a blue and green shield with a white sail and a yellow scroll inscribed Cirák.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: four diagonal bands from the corners, not meeting at the centre
